dialogues.speaker: Soltani
dialogues.text: Hello, would you like to let me show you the way?

dialogues.speaker: Soltani
dialogues.text: I'm a servant of this house at your service.

dialogues.speaker: Soltani
dialogues.text: Seeing as how you've been wandering aimlessly. Please pardon me... Is the butler giving random directions again?

dialogues.speaker: Soltani
dialogues.text: *sigh* If you had the "privilege" to speak to the butler, then please don't take him seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Soltani
dialogues.text: This place may seem grand and magnificent, but it's still quite remote and isolated compared to the city. The Lord prefers a life of tranquility and reclusiveness, so our household staff is limited in numbers.

dialogues.speaker: Soltani
dialogues.text: I suggest you pay attention to your surroundings when going while in the vicinity, especially when you're not within the range of this property.

dialogues.speaker: Soltani
dialogues.text: It's nothing. I was just speaking from experience.

dialogues.speaker: Soltani
dialogues.text: It is hard to meet someone as sensible and open to suggestions as you are.
